title: Seldinger Phase 7b healthcare-CV evaluation-harness public release
data_policy: Public/non-PHI derived tables and figure scripts only; raw MedMNIST data are not copied.

public_datasets.name: MedMNIST v2 ChestMNIST
public_datasets.canonical_reference: Yang et al., Scientific Data 2023, doi:10.1038/s41597-022-01721-8
public_datasets.download_command: python -c "from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download; hf_hub_download(repo_id='albertvillanova/medmnist-v2', repo_type='dataset', filename='data/chestmnist.npz')"
public_datasets.split: official MedMNIST v2 train/val/test split; selected run used test rows reported in results CSV
